verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only human-facing portal pages and a 'Data and Image Subscriptions' menu label. Nothing documents an OpenAPI spec, XML schema, or data dictionary for any machine channel. The 'software providers' resources link belongs to the Department of Revenue, and its content is not shown, so it cannot be credited here.
